_readme: How each form from the old Squarespace site is handled now.
'hubspot'    - render the HubSpot embed. Needs hubspot.portalId + hubspot.formId.
Submissions land in HubSpot, same as the footer newsletter.
'deploybase' - POST to a deploybase form. Needs deploybaseFormId (the part
after /f/ shown on the form's page in the dashboard).
null         - not connected. The page shows a visible notice instead of a
submit button, so a form can never silently eat a message.
The keys are the original Squarespace form ids; the page blocks reference them.
